dataList.content:
I can see their similarities with humans... but they certainly aren't humans.
虽然也有和人类相似的部分……但这些叫做小矮人的，肯定不是人类吧。
dataList.place:
Gift Factory Reception Hall
礼物工厂 接待室

dataList.content:
Except for their odd verbal quirk, these monsters are impressively communicative—I don't even know if they should be categorized as 'monsters'.
除了带着奇怪的口癖以外……这些怪物的语言能力竟然这么高，都不知道该不该称它们为怪物。

The definition is often arbitrary. Some may call them monsters, yet others may call them members of a different, sentient, race.
这取决于定义。有些人会将它们称为怪物，而有些人又会将它们定为其他种族。

<I appreciate your analyses, but we should probably get moving. We still don't know where Heathcliff and Don Quixote are.>
<分析未尝不可，不过还是先找到希斯克利夫和堂吉诃德吧。>

You always say the right things at the right time, Executive Manager.
您的言论一如既往正确无误。执行经理。

Exploring the Outskirts area will carry higher risks than our usual operation grounds. To ensure the Manager's safety, we must first establish a more structured plan—
郊区地带的危险程度比我们平常进行作战的地点更高。考虑到需要贴身保护执行经理，应当制定更为系统的计划……

Well, I'd say the easiest answer would be to leave the two of them. But the easiest path isn't always the right one.
好吧，虽然最简单的方法是放弃他们两个，但这并不是最优选择。
dataList.place:
Gift Factory Packaging Line
礼物工厂 包装线

dataList.content:
Ishmael kicked open the door the gnomes rushed in from.
以实玛利一边说着，一边踹开了小矮人们进来的那扇门。

Come on, let's go. We'll protect the Manager and save Heathcliff and Don Quixote.
走吧。让我们保护好经理，然后救出他们两个吧？
